verdict.rationale: PagerDuty documents Events API v2 as a reliable, self-describing ingestion endpoint for monitoring alerts (confirmed live via runtime probe), plus Event Orchestration for condition-based routing/deduplication and Escalation Policies to route to the right team/individual per configurable rules. This directly matches the story of documented ingestion sources routed by defined conditions to the correct team.  missing for 10: independent hands-on validation of complex routing/orchestration setups (community evidence only covers general escalation behavior and unrelated API versioning friction, not routing-condition failures).
